content.title: Offline content and drives
content.lead.ok: Everything is here and checked. It works without the internet.
content.lead.noRoot: No disk with content is ready. Plug in the AI-ARK drive, or run Install what's missing.
content.lead.nextSync: Some content is missing. Next step: press Sync now.
content.lead.nextCopy: Some content is missing. Next step: press Copy from this drive.
content.lead.nextConnect: Some content is missing. Next step: connect to the internet, or plug in the AI-ARK drive.
content.ready.title: Is it ready?
content.run.title: Update and check
content.run.stopping: Stopping … What is half done is kept and continues next time.
content.run.partial: The last run finished, but {n} items did not work. The older copies are kept.
content.run.partialOne: The last run finished, but 1 item did not work. The older copy is kept.
content.run.partialNoCount: The last run finished, but some items were left for next time. The older copies are kept.
content.run.cancelled: The last run was stopped. It continues where it left off next time.
content.run.skipped: The last run did not start.
content.run.failed: The last run did not work.
content.sync.started: The download started. You can keep using the computer.
content.stop.done: Stopping. Nothing is lost; it continues next time.
content.verify.what: Check content reads every copy on this computer and the drives and sets aside a damaged one. It works without the internet.
content.why.busy: Wait until the current work finishes, or press Stop.
content.why.unclean: This drive needs a repair first.
content.why.empty: This drive is empty. Prepare it first.
content.why.notMountedEject: The drive is not open, so you can unplug it now.
content.why.unusable: Local AI cannot use this drive.
content.items.title: What is on each disk
content.items.empty: Nothing is planned for this disk.
content.item.stale: Ready; a newer version is not downloaded yet
content.item.quarantined: Damaged copy set aside; it will be downloaded again
content.item.blocked: Skipped until a new version is published
content.item.failed: The download did not work; it will be tried again
content.item.orphan: Not in the plan; it can be removed to free space
content.item.skippedBudget: Skipped: it does not fit in the space set aside
content.item.skippedDisk: Skipped: the disk is too full
content.item.skippedTime: Not reached yet; the next sync continues
content.drives.title: AI-ARK drives
content.drives.none: No AI-ARK drive is connected. Plug one in to copy content from it or to keep a copy on it.
content.drive.name: {label}, {size}
content.drive.incomplete: Not complete. Sync now fills it.
content.drive.readOnly: Read only: content can be copied from it, not to it
content.drive.unclean: Needs a repair before it can be used
content.drive.uninitialized: Empty: not prepared for Local AI yet
content.copy.started: Copying started. Nothing on this computer is deleted.
content.eject.started: Ejecting. Do not unplug the drive yet.
content.eject.waiting: Wait: the drive is finishing. Do not unplug it yet.
content.eject.safe: {name}: you can unplug the drive now.
content.eject.notDone: The drive could not be ejected. Close what uses it and press Eject safely again.
content.eject.force1: The brain running from this drive will be stopped.
content.eject.force2: You can choose a brain again in AI models after that.
content.init.confirm1: This makes the drive an AI-ARK drive: it adds a localai folder and a label file to it.
content.init.confirm2: Nothing already on the drive is deleted. A drive that already has a localai folder with files is refused.
content.init.confirm3: Afterwards, Sync now or Copy fills it. It needs the admin PIN.
content.init.pinWhy: Preparing a drive changes it, so it needs the admin PIN.
content.init.done: The drive is ready for Local AI. Press Sync now to fill it.
content.prune.title: Free up space
content.prune.what: Removes content that is no longer in the plan and old copies that a newer one replaced. The last good copy of anything is always kept.
content.prune: Remove content not in the plan
content.prune.pinWhy: This deletes content from this computer, so it needs the admin PIN. First you will see exactly what would be removed.
content.prune.nothing: Nothing to remove: everything here is in the plan.
content.prune.confirm2: They cannot be brought back without the internet or an AI-ARK drive that has them.
content.prune.kept: Kept, because it is the only good copy: {names}
